title: Claim
description: A finding, failed hypothesis, or binding constraint that may enter shared state only when admitted against evidence. Status admitted requires a non-empty evidence_refs list plus admitted_by and admitted_at. Status rejected and stale require a reason.

statement.description: The claim text shown to the next worker when status is admitted. Do not invent prose — copy from the source finding.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the UTF-8 encoded statement, so a later reader can tell whether the claim text changed after admission.

admitted_by.description: Agent or role that admitted the claim. Required when status is admitted.

admitted_at.description: When the claim was admitted. Required when status is admitted.

reason.description: Why the claim was rejected or marked stale. Required when status is rejected or stale.

allOf.description: Admitted claims must be grounded: non-empty evidence_refs, who admitted, and when.
Rejected and stale claims carry a reason.

uri.description: Relative path, git SHA, or Firebase Storage signed URL

captured_by.description: Agent or tool that captured the evidence
